products.name: Decktopus
products.note: AI presentation maker; automated design; content generation; data exposure

reading.body:
Decktopus is a presentation automation tool that generates complete slide decks, including structure, content, and design, from a topic or uploaded file, with brand integration from website URLs.

The product sits in the narrow space between content generation and interface design. Users describe a topic or provide source material, and the system produces both the words and the visual layout automatically. This collapses two separate labor costs into compute. The tool integrates with ChatGPT and Zapier, embedding it into workflows rather than requiring a separate application context. For AI infrastructure, this means presentation creation is now another workload that can run on cloud compute rather than human time.

The security posture suggests awareness of data sensitivity. Encryption in transit and at rest are standard for any SaaS handling business information. The stated policy against using customer data for AI training is notable because it is stated, meaning this is a decision point companies handling generative AI systems must now make explicitly. The data exposure flag indicates this particular commitment has been tested or questioned at some point.

This does not clarify whether the tool uses model APIs from third parties or runs inference on Decktopus infrastructure, which determines actual compute consumption. The profile provides no information on user volume, deck generation frequency, or the model size required for the task. Without these, the power and grid implications remain unknown.

profile_text.body:
Decktopus is a Turkish software company that offers an AI-powered presentation tool of the same name. The company describes its product as an AI presentation maker that generates a complete deck, including structure, content, and design, from a topic description or uploaded file. Users can also provide a website URL to have the tool pull in brand colors, fonts, and a logo automatically.

The Decktopus product is categorized as a slides and presentations tool and includes features such as automated design, content generation, Zapier integration for workflow automation, and availability as an app inside ChatGPT. The platform does not offer a free plan but provides free credits at signup for a three-slide presentation. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256 on AWS infrastructure, and the company states it does not use customer data for AI training; SOC 2 Type II compliance is described as currently in progress.

The site's held facts note a data exposure flag against the product listing. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
